free.label: REFLUX FREE v1.0.24
free.message: Home Command Center now fits Backup, Custom Profile, Thermals, and Restore on one row so the page does not scroll. Applied tweak toggles stay on after you close REFLUX. Process Killer is unlocked with the same picker — scan first, uncheck what stays, then Apply.

pro.label: REFLUX PRO v1.0.33
pro.message: Home Command Center now fits Backup, Custom Profile, Thermals, and Restore on one row so the page does not scroll. Smart Optimizer is redesigned with toggles that stay on after you close the app. Extreme Process Killer now warns what it will close, lets you uncheck apps, then Apply.
